label: CARD-NLR endonuclease system
definition: A CARD-NLR system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder CARD_NLR_Endonuclease subtype locus represented by the CARD_NLR__Endonuclease mandatory rule profile.
observations: CARD-NLR endonuclease branch under CARD-NLR system; distinct from the broader CARD-NLR system, individual CARD_NLR_Endonuclease or accessory HMM profile rows, unresolved phage triggers, native host breadth, CARD-to-effector activation sequence, exact endonuclease effector substrate, and other CARD_NLR subtypes.
